facts.text: University of Memphis guarantees admission to students who earn an associate degree (AA/AS) or have a transfer GPA of 2.5 or higher with at least 15 college credits.

sources.title: Guaranteed Admission Pathways - The University of Memphis
sources.quote: There are five pathways for which a student can earn guaranteed admission as an undergraduate student: Earned an Associates degree (AA/AS) from an accredited community college.

sources.title: Guaranteed Admission Pathways - The University of Memphis
sources.quote: A calculated transfer GPA of 2.5 or greater with at least 15 earned hours of college-level credit (excluding developmental coursework).
